_note: 學習路徑內容建置第13批 #2／6：原因子句 because／since／as（eng.t_mid.conj.subordinate-reason，會考級／中階）。because／since／as 引導原因子句回答『為什麼』：I stayed home because I was sick。because 最直接、最強調原因（回答 why）；since／as 用於已知或較不強調的原因。鐵律：because 不和 so 在同一句並用（用其一）；because＋子句、because of＋名詞。誘答以『結果連接詞 so／讓步 although／because of＋名詞／because＋so 並用』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rsc_）。

units.title_zh: 原因子句 because／since／as（說明為什麼）
units.can_do: 我能用 because／since／as 引導原因子句說明『為什麼』（I stayed home because I was sick），知道 because 最直接強調原因、而且 because 不和 so 在同一句並用，也能分辨 because＋子句與 because of＋名詞。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'Because', 'since' and 'as' introduce a reason clause that answers the question 'why': 'I stayed home because I was sick.'
claims.verification_ref: because/since/as 引導原因子句、回答 why；I stayed home because I was sick；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Because' gives the most direct reason and is the natural word to answer a 'why' question, including as a short answer: 'Why were you late?' — 'Because the bus was late.'
claims.verification_ref: because 最直接、回答 why 問句的自然用詞、可當簡答；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: We do not use 'because' and 'so' together in one sentence; English uses one or the other — 'because' for the reason, or 'so' for the result: 'Because it rained, we stayed in.' OR 'It rained, so we stayed in.'
claims.verification_ref: because 與 so 不同句並用；用其一；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Because' is followed by a clause (subject + verb), while 'because of' is followed by a noun or noun phrase: 'We stayed in because it rained' / 'We stayed in because of the rain.'
claims.verification_ref: because＋子句、because of＋名詞；because of the rain；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 要說明一件事的『原因、為什麼』，可以用 because／since／as 帶出一個原因子句：I stayed home because I was sick.（我待在家，因為我生病了。）because 後面的 I was sick 就是原因。
I stayed home because I was sick.　（我待在家，因為我生病了。）
because 最直接、最強調原因，也是回答 why 問句時最自然的用詞。since／as 用在原因已經知道、或比較不強調的時候，常放句子前面：Since it was raining, we stayed inside.（既然在下雨，我們就待在裡面。）
Since it was raining, we stayed inside.　（既然在下雨，我們就待在裡面。）
注意：because 不和 so 在同一句並用——用 because 帶原因，或用 so 帶結果，選一個就好。另外 because 後面接『子句』（有主詞＋動詞），because of 後面接『名詞』。
It was late, so we went home.　（時間晚了，所以我們回家了。so 帶出結果。）

practice.stem: 回答 why 問句：'Why were you late?' — '____ the bus was late.'（因為公車誤點）

distractor_rationales.So: so 帶出『結果』，不是原因；回答 why 要用 because。
distractor_rationales.But: but 表『但是』的轉折，不回答原因。
distractor_rationales.And: and 表『而且』，不回答原因。

practice.feedback: 回答 why 用 because：Because the bus was late。

practice.answer: Because it rained, we stayed inside.
options: Because it rained, we stayed inside.
Because it rained, so we stayed inside.
Because of it rained, we stayed inside.
Because it rained, so stayed we inside.

because 和 so 不同句並用；用其一即可。
because of 後面接名詞，不接子句 it rained；子句要用 because。
because 和 so 不並用，且 stayed we 語序錯。

practice.feedback: because 帶原因、不與 so 並用：Because it rained, we stayed inside。

practice.stem: 填入表『結果』的連接詞：It was raining, ____ we stayed inside.（下雨了，所以我們待在裡面）

distractor_rationales.because: because 帶『原因』；這裡逗號後是結果（待在裡面），要用 so。
distractor_rationales.although: although 表『雖然』的讓步，意思不合。

practice.feedback: 帶出結果用 so：It was raining, so we stayed inside。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：We canceled the picnic ____ the heavy rain.（因為大雨）

distractor_rationales.because: because 後面要接子句（主詞＋動詞）；後面是名詞 the heavy rain，要用 because of。
distractor_rationales.since: since 後面也要接子句；接名詞要用 because of。
distractor_rationales.as: as 後面也要接子句；接名詞要用 because of。

practice.feedback: 接名詞用 because of：because of the heavy rain。

practice.stem: 'Because it was cold, I didn't go out.' 的意思是？
practice.answer: 因為天氣冷，所以我沒出門
options: 因為天氣冷，所以我沒出門
雖然天氣冷，我還是出門了

distractor_rationales.雖然天氣冷，我還是出門了: didn't go out 是沒出門；because 給的是沒出門的原因。
distractor_rationales.我出門了，因為天氣冷: didn't go out＝沒出門，不是出門了。
distractor_rationales.我出門後天氣才變冷: because it was cold 是『因為冷』這個原因，不是時間先後。

practice.feedback: because it was cold 給出『沒出門』的原因：因為天氣冷所以沒出門。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I was late because I missed the bus.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：because 有沒有寫對、I missed the bus 有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。主句與 because 子句連貫、句尾下收。

lines.text: I went to bed early because I was very tired.
lines.intonation: I went to bed early 起、because I was very tired 連貫、句尾下收

lines.text: Since you are here, let's start now.
lines.intonation: Since you are here 微停、let's start now 句尾下收
